[package]
name = "image"
version = "0.25.9"
edition = "2021"
resolver = "2"
publish = false
rust-version = "1.88.0"
license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0"
description = "Imaging library. Provides basic image processing and encoders/decoders for common image formats."
authors = ["The image-rs Developers"]
readme = "README.md"
documentation = "https://docs.rs/image"
repository = "https://github.com/image-rs/image"
homepage = "https://github.com/image-rs/image"
categories = ["multimedia::images", "multimedia::encoding", "encoding"]
exclude = ["src/png/testdata/*", "examples/*", "tests/*"]
include = ["/LICENSE-APACHE", "/LICENSE-MIT", "/README.md", "/CHANGES.md", "/src/", "/benches/"]

[package.metadata.docs.rs]
all-features = true
rustdoc-args = ["--cfg", "docsrs"]

[package.metadata.cargo-semver-checks.lints.enum_discriminants_undefined_non_unit_variant]
level = "warn"

[dependencies]
byteorder-lite = "0.1.0"
pic-scale-safe = "0.1.5"

[dependencies.bytemuck]
version = "1.8.0"
features = ["extern_crate_alloc"]

[dependencies.moxcms]
version = "0.8.0"
default-features = false
features = ["avx_shaper_fixed_point_paths", "avx_shaper_paths", "neon_shaper_fixed_point_paths", "neon_shaper_paths", "sse_shaper_fixed_point_paths", "sse_shaper_paths"]

[dependencies.num-traits]
version = "0.2.0"

[dependencies.color_quant]
version = "1.1"
optional = true

[dependencies.dav1d]
version = "0.11"
optional = true

[dependencies.exr]
version = "1.74.0"
default-features = false
optional = true

[dependencies.gif]
version = "0.14.1"
optional = true

[dependencies.image-webp]
version = "0.2.0"
optional = true

[dependencies.mp4parse]
version = "0.17.0"
optional = true

[dependencies.png]
version = "0.18.0"
optional = true

[dependencies.qoi]
version = "0.4"
optional = true

[dependencies.ravif]
version = "0.13"
default-features = false
optional = true

[dependencies.rayon]
version = "1.7.0"
optional = true

[dependencies.rgb]
version = "0.8.48"
default-features = false
optional = true

[dependencies.tiff]
version = "0.11.2"
optional = true

[dependencies.zune-core]
version = "0.5.0"
default-features = false
optional = true

[dependencies.zune-jpeg]
version = "0.5.15"
optional = true

[dependencies.jpeg-encoder]
version = "0.7.0"
optional = true
features = ["simd"]

[dependencies.serde]
version = "1.0.214"
optional = true
features = ["derive"]

[dev-dependencies]
num-complex = "0.4"
glob = "0.3"
quickcheck = "1"
criterion = "0.5.0"
libtest-mimic = "0.8.1"
walkdir = "2.5.0"

[features]
default = ["rayon", "default-formats"]
default-formats = ["avif", "bmp", "exr", "ff", "gif", "hdr", "ico", "jpeg", "png", "pnm", "qoi", "tga", "tiff", "webp"]
avif = ["dep:ravif", "dep:rgb"]
bmp = []
exr = ["dep:exr"]
ff = []
gif = ["dep:gif", "dep:color_quant"]
hdr = []
ico = ["bmp", "png"]
jpeg = ["dep:zune-core", "dep:zune-jpeg", "dep:jpeg-encoder"]
png = ["dep:png"]
pnm = []
qoi = ["dep:qoi"]
tga = []
tiff = ["dep:tiff"]
webp = ["dep:image-webp"]
rayon = ["dep:rayon", "ravif?/threading", "exr?/rayon"]
nasm = ["ravif?/asm"]
color_quant = ["dep:color_quant"]
avif-native = ["dep:mp4parse", "dep:dav1d"]
benchmarks = []
serde = ["dep:serde"]

[[example]]
name = "bmp_1bit_encoding"
required-features = ["bmp"]

[[bench]]
path = "benches/decode.rs"
name = "decode"
harness = false

[[bench]]
path = "benches/encode.rs"
name = "encode"
harness = false

[[bench]]
name = "copy_from"
harness = false

[[bench]]
path = "benches/blur.rs"
name = "blur"
harness = false

[[bench]]
path = "benches/convert.rs"
name = "convert"
harness = false

[[bench]]
path = "benches/imageops.rs"
name = "imageops"
harness = false

[[bench]]
path = "benches/bgra_to_rgba.rs"
name = "bgra_to_rgba"
harness = false

[[test]]
path = "tests/reference_images.rs"
name = "reference_images"
harness = false

[package]
name = "mitex"
description = "MiTeX is a TeX2Typst converter."
authors = ["Myriad-Dreamin <camiyoru@gmail.com>", "OrangeX4 <orangex4@qq.com>", "mgt <mgt@oi-wiki.org>"]
version = "0.2.7"
license = "Apache-2.0"
edition = "2021"
homepage = "https://github.com/mitex-rs/mitex"
repository = "https://github.com/mitex-rs/mitex"

[[bench]]
name = "convert_large_projects"
harness = false

[dependencies]
rowan = "0.15.15"

[dependencies.mitex-parser]
version = "0.2.7"
path = "crates/mitex-parser"

[dependencies.mitex-spec-gen]
version = "0.2.7"
path = "crates/mitex-spec-gen"

[dev-dependencies]
insta = "1.39"
divan = "0.1.14"
serde = "1.0.188"
serde_json = "1.0.106"

[package]
name = "mitex-glob"
description = "Glob impl for MiTeX"
authors = ["Myriad-Dreamin <camiyoru@gmail.com>", "OrangeX4 <orangex4@qq.com>", "mgt <mgt@oi-wiki.org>"]
version = "0.2.7"
license = "Apache-2.0"
edition = "2021"
homepage = "https://github.com/mitex-rs/mitex"
repository = "https://github.com/mitex-rs/mitex"

[features]
glob-tests = []

[package]
name = "mitex-lexer"
description = "Lexer for MiTeX"
authors = ["Myriad-Dreamin <camiyoru@gmail.com>", "OrangeX4 <orangex4@qq.com>", "mgt <mgt@oi-wiki.org>"]
version = "0.2.7"
license = "Apache-2.0"
edition = "2021"
homepage = "https://github.com/mitex-rs/mitex"
repository = "https://github.com/mitex-rs/mitex"

[dependencies]
logos = "0.14.0"
ena = "0.14.3"
ecow = "0.2.2"
rustc-hash = "2"
once_cell = "1"

[dependencies.mitex-spec]
version = "0.2.7"
path = "crates/mitex-spec"

[dev-dependencies]
insta = "1.39"
divan = "0.1.14"

[dev-dependencies.mitex-spec-gen]
version = "0.2.7"
path = "crates/mitex-spec-gen"

[lints.rust]
missing_docs = "warn"

[lints.clippy]
uninlined_format_args = "warn"
missing_panics_doc = "warn"
missing_safety_doc = "warn"
undocumented_unsafe_blocks = "warn"

[package]
name = "mitex-parser"
description = "Parser for MiTeX"
authors = ["Myriad-Dreamin <camiyoru@gmail.com>", "OrangeX4 <orangex4@qq.com>", "mgt <mgt@oi-wiki.org>"]
version = "0.2.7"
license = "Apache-2.0"
edition = "2021"
homepage = "https://github.com/mitex-rs/mitex"
repository = "https://github.com/mitex-rs/mitex"

[[bench]]
name = "simple"
harness = false

[dependencies]
rowan = "0.15.15"

[dependencies.mitex-glob]
version = "0.2.7"
path = "crates/mitex-glob"

[dependencies.mitex-lexer]
version = "0.2.7"
path = "crates/mitex-lexer"

[dependencies.mitex-spec]
version = "0.2.7"
path = "crates/mitex-spec"

[dev-dependencies]
once_cell = "1"
insta = "1.39"
divan = "0.1.14"

[dev-dependencies.mitex-spec-gen]
version = "0.2.7"
path = "crates/mitex-spec-gen"

[lints.rust]
missing_docs = "warn"

[lints.clippy]
uninlined_format_args = "warn"
missing_panics_doc = "warn"
missing_safety_doc = "warn"
undocumented_unsafe_blocks = "warn"

[package]
name = "mitex-spec"
description = "Specification Library for MiTeX"
authors = ["Myriad-Dreamin <camiyoru@gmail.com>", "OrangeX4 <orangex4@qq.com>", "mgt <mgt@oi-wiki.org>"]
version = "0.2.7"
license = "Apache-2.0"
edition = "2021"
homepage = "https://github.com/mitex-rs/mitex"
repository = "https://github.com/mitex-rs/mitex"

[[bench]]
name = "spec_constructions"
harness = false

[dependencies]
serde_json = "1.0.106"
rustc-hash = "2"

[dependencies.rkyv]
optional = true
version = "0.7.42"

[dependencies.serde]
features = ["derive"]
optional = true
version = "1.0.188"

[features]
rkyv = ["dep:rkyv", "rkyv/alloc", "rkyv/archive_le"]
rkyv-validation = ["dep:rkyv", "rkyv/validation"]
default = ["serde", "rkyv", "rkyv-validation"]

[dev-dependencies]
once_cell = "1"
divan = "0.1.14"

[lints.rust]
missing_docs = "warn"

[lints.clippy]
uninlined_format_args = "warn"
missing_panics_doc = "warn"
missing_safety_doc = "warn"
undocumented_unsafe_blocks = "warn"

[source.vendored-sources]
directory = "cargo/vendor"

[source.crates-io]
replace-with = "vendored-sources"

[source."https://github.com/image-rs/image"]
git = "https://github.com/image-rs/image"
replace-with = "vendored-sources"
rev = "2397f31b08b57c3a8ffbfdcd27b614539f88fd63"

[source."https://github.com/mitex-rs/mitex"]
git = "https://github.com/mitex-rs/mitex"
replace-with = "vendored-sources"
tag = "0.2.7"
